title: Alabama AG subpoenas OpenAI over 'AI lab leak' that breached Hugging Face
summary: Alabama's attorney general opened a consumer-protection investigation into OpenAI and Sam Altman and demanded records over the July autonomous-agent breach of Hugging Face.
reason: First formal state investigation of an AI loss-of-control incident; accountability pressure.

title: Ukraine says Russian drone picked target autonomously, killing three civilians
summary: Ukrainian investigators said a Russian drone using an Nvidia Jetson Orin module selected its target without human input in a July 6 strike that killed three civilians; Nvidia confirmed the module.
reason: Reported lethal autonomous targeting in war; single incident, attribution by one party, so T2 not T3.

title: UK gains access to Ukraine's 'Avengers' AI battlefield data platform
summary: The UK became the first foreign partner to access battlefield sensor data from Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs under a non-binding pilot declaration.
reason: Military AI cooperation using combat data; pilot-scale.

title: European regulator fines Uber €825M over automated driver deactivations
summary: Uber was fined about €825 million for deactivating drivers for suspected fraud or low ratings without human review; Uber will appeal. (Roundup calls it the Dutch DPA; link is CNIL's English page.)
reason: Large GDPR fine against automated decisions without human review; pushes back algorithmic control.

title: Taiwan indicts nine over Nvidia B300 servers smuggled to China
summary: Taiwanese prosecutors alleged 74 Nvidia B300 servers reached China via third countries, with 56 intercepted, and charged nine people.
reason: Enforcement of chip export controls; small scale.

title: Chinese state hackers doubled attacks using DeepSeek, TeamT5 says
summary: Taiwanese security firm TeamT5 told Bloomberg that China-linked state groups more than doubled attacks after adding AI tools, often DeepSeek.
reason: AI-enabled state cyber operations at scale; F8 T2 'AI-enabled cyberattack'.
